title: Poolboy command reference
description: Generated reference for Poolboy's CLI commands and flags.
intro: Use a leading --root DIR or --root=DIR to select a project. Result commands accept --format text|json|csv|tsv; exit status is 0 for success, 1 for no match or check failures, and 2 for errors.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: Scaffold a documentation project in an optional directory and report existing Markdown adoption issues; existing files are preserved unless --force is used.

flags.name: [dir]
flags.description: Target directory; defaults to the current directory.

commands.effects: Writes starter project files into the target directory and reports Markdown adoption issues; existing files are preserved unless --force is given.
commands.does_not: Does not build, publish, or sign anything, and without --force does not overwrite existing files.

commands.name: build
commands.summary: Render and publish the configured corpus.

flags.name: --renderer PATH
flags.description: Use a trusted Knap companion path.

commands.effects: Renders the configured corpus and writes the published output.
commands.does_not: Does not sign, approve, or verify the output; building does not imply review or established trust.

commands.name: preview
commands.summary: Build and serve the configured corpus through a private loopback URL.

flags.name: --port N
flags.description: Use a loopback port; 0 chooses an available port.

flags.name: --renderer PATH
flags.description: Use a trusted Knap companion path.

commands.effects: Builds the corpus and serves it at a private loopback URL until the process is stopped.
commands.does_not: Does not publish the corpus or expose it beyond loopback.

commands.name: scan
commands.summary: Record a bounded source inventory baseline and summarize documentation health.

flags.name: --accept
flags.description: Replace an existing baseline after review.

commands.effects: Records a bounded source inventory baseline and summarizes documentation health.
commands.does_not: Does not build, publish, or review documentation.

commands.name: drift
commands.summary: Compare current sources and summarize affected documentation.
commands.effects: Compares current sources against the recorded baseline and summarizes affected documentation; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not record or update the baseline.

commands.name: health
commands.summary: Inspect documentation provenance and graph evidence.
commands.effects: Reports documentation provenance and graph evidence; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not change provenance, graph evidence, or corpus files.

commands.name: affected
commands.summary: Find documents citing a source resource directly.
commands.effects: Lists documents that cite the given source resource directly; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify entries or the source inventory.

commands.name: checkout
commands.summary: Create an asynchronous ordinary-Markdown checkout outside the project root and record its exact private comparison base.

flags.name: DIR
flags.description: New checkout directory outside the project root; its parent must exist.

flags.name: --format text|json|csv|tsv
flags.description: Choose result output format; agents should use JSON.

commands.effects: Creates an ordinary-Markdown checkout at DIR outside the project root and records its private comparison base.
commands.does_not: Does not modify the canonical corpus.

commands.name: checkin
commands.summary: Compare checkout, base, and canonical corpus revisions; preview by default and apply only a conflict-free plan.

flags.name: DIR
flags.description: Checkout directory previously created for this project.

flags.name: --apply
flags.description: Apply a conflict-free file-level plan to the canonical corpus.

flags.name: --format text|json|csv|tsv
flags.description: Choose result output format; JSON exposes variance, conflicts, can_apply, and applied.

commands.effects: Compares checkout, base, and canonical revisions; previews the plan by default and applies a conflict-free plan only with --apply.
commands.does_not: Without --apply, does not modify the canonical corpus, and never applies a plan with conflicts.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: Report corpus counts for entries, links, tags, checkboxes, broken links, and orphans.
commands.effects: Reports corpus counts for entries, links, tags, checkboxes, broken links, and orphans; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify the corpus or its index.

commands.name: list
commands.summary: List indexed entries.

flags.name: --where KEY=VALUE|KEY!=VALUE
flags.description: Repeatable frontmatter filter; filters are ANDed.

flags.name: --sort path|timestamp
flags.description: Sort by path or newest-first timestamp.

commands.usage: poolboy list [--prefix PATH] [--where KEY=VALUE|KEY!=VALUE] [--sort path|timestamp] [--reverse] [--format text|json|csv|tsv]
commands.effects: Lists indexed entries, filtered and ordered by the given options; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify indexed entries.

commands.name: read
commands.summary: Print one entry body with frontmatter stripped.
commands.effects: Prints one entry body with frontmatter stripped; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify the entry.

commands.name: outline
commands.summary: Print one entry's heading hierarchy.
commands.effects: Prints one entry's heading hierarchy; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify the entry.

commands.name: table
commands.summary: Extract one Markdown table from an entry.

flags.name: --n N
flags.description: Select a table by one-based index when there are several.

commands.effects: Extracts one Markdown table from an entry; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify the entry.

commands.name: search
commands.summary: Search entry text; every query word must match by default.

flags.name: QUERY
flags.description: One non-empty query; quote multi-word phrases.

flags.name: --exact
flags.description: Match the verbatim phrase; mutually exclusive with --any.

flags.name: --lines
flags.description: Show matching lines instead of entries.

commands.usage: poolboy search QUERY [--any] [--exact] [--lines] [--prefix PATH] [--where KEY=VALUE|KEY!=VALUE] [--format text|json|csv|tsv]
commands.effects: Searches entry text, requiring every query word to match by default; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify entries or search state.

commands.name: checkboxes
commands.summary: List GFM checklist items; an optional file scopes the result.

flags.name: [FILE]
flags.description: Optionally limit checklist results to one entry.

commands.effects: Lists GFM checklist items across selected entries; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify checklist items.

commands.name: tags
commands.summary: List tags in use across selected entries.

flags.name: --sort name|count
flags.description: Sort by tag name or count.

commands.usage: poolboy tags [--counts] [--sort name|count] [--prefix PATH] [--where KEY=VALUE|KEY!=VALUE] [--format text|json|csv|tsv]
commands.effects: Lists tags in use across selected entries; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify entries or tags.

commands.name: properties
commands.summary: List frontmatter property keys in use.

flags.name: --sort name|count
flags.description: Sort by property name or count.

commands.usage: poolboy properties [--counts] [--sort name|count] [--prefix PATH] [--where KEY=VALUE|KEY!=VALUE] [--format text|json|csv|tsv]
commands.effects: Lists frontmatter property keys in use across selected entries; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify entries or property keys.

commands.name: property
commands.summary: List values for one frontmatter property.

flags.name: --sort name|count
flags.description: Sort by value name or count.

commands.usage: poolboy property NAME [--counts] [--sort name|count] [--prefix PATH] [--where KEY=VALUE|KEY!=VALUE] [--format text|json|csv|tsv]
commands.effects: Lists the values in use for one frontmatter property; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify entries or property values.

commands.name: unresolved
commands.summary: List broken internal links.
commands.effects: Lists broken internal links across the corpus; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not repair broken links.

commands.name: orphans
commands.summary: List entries with no incoming links.
commands.effects: Lists entries with no incoming links; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify entries or links.

commands.name: links
commands.summary: List unique outgoing link targets from one entry.
commands.effects: Lists unique outgoing link targets from one entry; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify links.

commands.name: backlinks
commands.summary: List every incoming link reference to one entry.
commands.effects: Lists every incoming link reference to one entry; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not modify links.

commands.name: move
commands.summary: Relocate an entry and rewrite Markdown links.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: Preview the rewrite plan without writing.

commands.effects: Relocates an entry from SRC to DEST and rewrites Markdown links pointing at it.
commands.does_not: With --dry-run, previews the plan and does not write any files.

commands.name: tidy
commands.summary: Preview or apply canonical link, filename, and wikilink cleanup.

flags.name: --slug
flags.description: Slugify spaced filenames and rewrite inbound links.

flags.name: --all
flags.description: Apply every category; bare tidy is preview-only.

commands.effects: Applies the selected link, filename, and wikilink cleanup category, or every category with --all.
commands.does_not: Bare tidy is preview-only and does not modify any files.

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Report conformance and corpus health issues.

flags.name: --fix
flags.description: Apply safe repairs, such as syncing okf_version.

commands.effects: Reports conformance and corpus health issues; with --fix applies safe repairs such as syncing okf_version.
commands.does_not: Does not publish, review, or approve; without --fix it does not modify any files.

commands.name: keygen
commands.summary: Generate a private Ed25519 key for explicit TOFU publishing.

flags.name: --out PATH
flags.description: Private key destination; defaults to poolboy.key.

commands.effects: Writes a private Ed25519 key file, defaulting to poolboy.key.
commands.does_not: Does not sign or publish anything, and without --force does not overwrite an existing key file.

commands.name: sign
commands.summary: Sign the built graph for explicit Ed25519 TOFU verification.

flags.name: --key PATH
flags.description: Private key file; alternatively set POOLBOY_SIGNING_KEY.

flags.name: --root PATH
flags.description: Project root or directory containing poolboy.toml.

commands.effects: Signs the built graph for explicit Ed25519 TOFU verification.
commands.does_not: Asserts authorship only; does not approve the release or establish trust for consumers.

commands.name: verify
commands.summary: Verify an approved exact corpus release or report a pending update.

flags.name: DIR-OR-URL
flags.description: Local publication directory or HTTP(S) publication root.

flags.name: --lock PATH
flags.description: Use an authoritative project trust lock.

flags.name: --identity URI
flags.description: Require an exact Sigstore workflow identity on first contact.

flags.name: --tofu
flags.description: Explicitly use weaker Ed25519 trust on first use.

commands.usage: poolboy verify DIR-OR-URL [--lock PATH] [--identity URI] [--tofu] [--channel NAME]
commands.effects: Verifies an approved exact corpus release or reports a pending update; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not approve or record trust; verification alone does not grant approval.

commands.name: approve
commands.summary: Fully verify and interactively approve one exact corpus digest.

flags.name: DIR-OR-URL
flags.description: Local publication directory or HTTP(S) publication root.

flags.name: --lock PATH
flags.description: Write the authoritative project trust lock.

flags.name: --identity URI
flags.description: Require an exact Sigstore workflow identity.

flags.name: --tofu
flags.description: Explicitly use weaker Ed25519 trust on first use.

flags.name: --minimum-release-age DURATION
flags.description: Minimum trusted release age; stable Sigstore defaults to 72h.

flags.name: --override-age
flags.description: Record a human emergency override for this exact digest.

flags.name: --migrate-identity
flags.description: Explicitly replace an existing publisher identity or TOFU key.

commands.usage: poolboy approve DIR-OR-URL [--lock PATH] [--identity URI] [--tofu] [--channel NAME] [--minimum-release-age DURATION] [--override-age] [--migrate-identity]
commands.effects: Fully verifies and interactively records approval of one exact corpus digest in the selected trust store.
commands.does_not: Does not modify the corpus; approves only the exact digest presented.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: Print the Poolboy version as a bare string.
commands.effects: Prints the Poolboy version as a bare string; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not inspect or modify the corpus.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: Print the top-level usage and command list.
commands.effects: Prints the top-level usage and command list; read-only.
commands.does_not: Does not run a command or modify the corpus.
